title: First Aid
subtitle: What to do in the first few minutes of a medical emergency
lede: A reference to {videos} sources on immediate first-aid response — the first few minutes before or instead of professional help.
about_paragraphs: A reference built from {videos} sources on basic emergency first aid — recovery position, choking, drowning, bleeding, and other rescue basics — synthesised into {library_files} knowledge files and {glossary_terms} glossary terms.

Every claim traces to a specific point in a specific source — a video timestamp. Nothing here is generated: there is no model in this app, and it makes no network requests. It works offline, permanently.
catalog_description: Every transcript ingested into this knowledge package, with the subjects, emergencies, procedures, and concepts each one covers.
